title: Vary the outfit across the dataset instead of keeping one outfit
body: A sheet-drawn character usually wears one outfit in every panel (today's default is a crew-neck sweater and dark jeans), and a LoRA trained on that may bind the sweater into the person. Build one dataset with a single outfit and one where outfits vary and are named in the captions, train both, and generate the suite's four-outfit prompts. Measure how often the requested outfit appears and whether face agreement holds. Varying wins if outfits follow the prompt clearly more often with face agreement no lower.
